brief.pitch: Bank pucks off corner bumpers, pounce on the kick, and score double.

aspects.title: Corner Bumpers
aspects.line: Hit a bumper and BANG, the puck flies back faster.
aspects.detail: Four cartridge obstacles of kind bumper, 3 m across, at x ±29, z ±12. The core returns the puck at restitution 1.6. The pack adds flash (TLVfx.burst sparks) and bang (TLAudio.play) within 3 frames.

alternatives.title: Slot Bumpers
alternatives.line: Two bumpers beside each net make wild close rebounds.

alternatives.title: Rubber Boards
alternatives.line: Whole walls bounce hard, so bank from anywhere.

aspects.title: Gold Puck
aspects.line: A bumped puck turns gold. Score fast for two!
aspects.detail: Pack scorekeeper reads the core snapshot: a loose puck bouncing off a bumper is gold for 180 frames (240 when trailing by two). A goal by that side adds one bonus point. Opponent possession kills gold. The simulation is untouched.

alternatives.title: Stacked Banks
alternatives.line: Two bumpers before the goal make it count three.

alternatives.title: Stolen Gold
alternatives.line: Grab their gold puck and the double becomes yours.

aspects.title: Fast and Slush
aspects.line: Zoom down orange lanes. Blue slush drags you back.
aspects.detail: Cartridge zones: two fast_ice side lanes, strength 0.8 (+40%), and two slow_ice circles in mid-ice, strength 0.6 (-30%). They affect skaters and puck. The base draws each with its own tint and mark.

alternatives.title: Guarded Slot
alternatives.line: Slush before each net makes every pounce a struggle.

alternatives.title: Express Middle
alternatives.line: A fast centre lane with slush along the walls.

aspects.title: The Pounce
aspects.line: Read the bounce, race to it, and bury it.
aspects.detail: Core skating, pickup and shot are unchanged in kind. Shot speed_scale 1.2 keeps kicks catchable; one-timer window 20 frames, 14 degree help, rewards feeding a mate across the crease.

alternatives.title: Setup Artist
alternatives.line: Bank it to your mate, who finishes it first time.

alternatives.title: Rocket Banks
alternatives.line: Blazing shots that can only be scored straight off bumpers.

aspects.title: The Wardens
aspects.line: One charges you, one guards home. Learn both.
aspects.detail: Core bots with roles chaser, two supports, back. Rookie never body checks and reads sticks 14 frames late; pro 8, all-star 5. Bot check wind-up 12 frames, the core's longest. They share your skater figure.

alternatives.title: Outnumbered
alternatives.line: Four of you face five of them on the pond.

alternatives.title: Heavy Wardens
alternatives.line: Big slow bruisers who flatten anyone chasing gold pucks.

aspects.title: Skater's Eye
aspects.line: Ride behind your skater and watch the bounce coming.
aspects.detail: thirdjam's camera unchanged: 6 m back, 3.5 m up, 5 m look-ahead, lag 4 frames, 70 degrees, bound to your skater, radar on. It never crosses the boards.

alternatives.title: High Chase
alternatives.line: A higher view shows two corners but smaller skaters.

alternatives.title: Whole Pond
alternatives.line: A fixed overhead view turns it into table hockey.

brief.rules:
FANTASY: I am the pond trickster who banks pucks off corner bumpers, pounces on the kick, and doubles the score. Sensation and challenge.
WORLD: Skater 0.8 m wide, 1.8 m tall; ice 70 x 35 m, 87 body widths long; top speed 14 widths a second; camera 6 m behind, 3.5 up, 3.3 body heights back.
TEARDOWN: NHL '94: pass as a mate crosses the crease, shoot as it arrives, the goalie cannot cross in time; copied as a one-timer window of 20 frames with 14 degrees help.
TEARDOWN: The Addams Family pinball: ball touches a pop bumper, leaves faster with instant flash and bang; copied as restitution 1.6, flash and sound within 3 frames, gold for 180 frames.
TEARDOWN: Mario Kart 8: a dash panel gives instant speed, off-road slows, so the line is a choice; copied as fast ice adding 40 percent and slush removing 30 percent.
30 SECONDS: 0-5 s the puck drops, you skate, one hint says bumpers make goals count double; 5-15 s you race an orange lane and fire into a corner: flash, bang, gold puck; 15-30 s you pounce on the kick, shoot before gold fades, see +2 and want another.
KILL IF: after ten bank shots a newcomer still cannot guess roughly where the bumper will send the puck.
KILL IF: the player skates straight at the net and ignores the bumpers for a whole match.
KILL IF: kicked pucks ring off or fly past the player every time, so nobody ever pounces.
KILL IF: after a double, the player cannot say why it counted two.
CARTRIDGE: game.rink.length_m = 70 (corners arrive sooner, still room to skate)
CARTRIDGE: game.rink.width_m = 35 (side lanes lead straight to the bumpers)
CARTRIDGE: game.rink.corner_radius_m = 3.5 (the puck rounds the corner behind each bumper)
CARTRIDGE: game.rink.obstacles = 4 of kind bumper, size 3, at (±29, ±12) (a hard kick in every corner)
CARTRIDGE: game.rink.zones = fast_ice rects at (0, ±13.5), w 36, d 5, strength 0.8; slow_ice circles at (±10, 0), r 4, strength 0.6 (fast wings, slow middle)
CARTRIDGE: game.rules.mode = "timer" (one full match, no early end)
CARTRIDGE: game.rules.timer_frames = 10800 (three minutes, then a rematch)
CARTRIDGE: game.rules.score_to_win = removed (only the clock ends it)
CARTRIDGE: game.teams = 4 v 4; blue #12A89D player, chaser, support, back; orange #E86A1C chaser, two supports, back (open lanes with a mate to feed)
CARTRIDGE: game.shot.speed_scale = 1.2 (kicked pucks stay chaseable)
CARTRIDGE: game.shot.one_timer.window_frames = 20 (shoot a feed as it arrives)
CARTRIDGE: game.shot.one_timer.cone_bonus_deg = 14 (first-time finishes feel fair)
CARTRIDGE: game.contact.bot_check_windup_frames = 12 (a longer look at the hit coming)
CARTRIDGE: game.look.tier = "l1_day" (a bright pond where patches read)
SKIN: title = Pond Trickster
SKIN: tagline = Bank it. Pounce. Count it twice.
SKIN: team_names = Mill Magpies, Pond Wardens
SKIN: level words = FIRST FROST, DEEP WINTER, BLACK ICE
SKIN: commentary = builtin
SCORING. Three minutes. A plain goal is 1. A gold goal is 2. Total = core goals + pack bonus. Equal totals: more doubles wins, else draw.
GOLD RULE (pack code, data/tuning.json). A loose puck that changes direction within bumper radius + puck radius + one frame of travel turns gold for the side that last released it. Window 180 frames; 240 for a side trailing by 2 or more, shown by a longer gold ring on the scoreboard. A new bumper touch restarts it. Opponent possession, a faceoff or a goal ends it; deflections and saves do not. A carried puck rubbing a bumper never turns gold. Gold is judged for both sides identically. The trailing window is a visible comeback rule for the person to judge; no rule exists to pass a bot figure.
HONEST LIMITS. The concept expected a rules sidecar. None of its switches says bumper kick or double goal, and unknown keys are errors, so no sidecar ships. The kick is a cartridge key; the double is a pack observer plus score plates, banner, end card and score commentary showing totals. First build task: prove the snapshot exposes puck velocity, possession and goals. If it cannot, the double needs a core patch and the producer is told before further work. Core bots do not know about gold: they bank only by accident.
VERBS. Shoot: 0/1/24, cooldown 24 is documented; hold charges. Pass: 0/1/24. Poke: 0/8/20. Check: 6/12/30, window 12 is documented. All other figures are provisional; the drill harness reads the core's real frames and they win. Core deke, spin, lift, sprint and brake stay unchanged.
FEEL AND SPEEDS. Skater 11 m/s, accel 12 m/s2, turn 5 rad/s; carrier 0.92, free skater 1.15. Fast ice +40%, slush -30%. Shot 18 m/s times 1.2, puck cap 36 m/s; bumper restitution 1.6. Contact is the core's momentum law: bump, stumble or down, each changing both bodies; a lunge that misses costs speed; a missed poke locks the stick. Bumper juice: 6-frame white flash, sparks, bang, gold trail; no shake. Double goal: horn, confetti, +2 banner, shake 0.2 m over 14 frames. Plain goal: the base's horn. Whiffs get no burst.
CONTACT TABLE. Check lands: attacker spends momentum, victim stumbles or falls and may drop the puck. Check misses: attacker loses speed. Poke lands: puck freed, carrier loses it. Poke misses: poker's stick locks. Teammate pass: seated on blade. Puck on bumper: faster rebound, flash.
CURVE. Calm faceoff, each gold puck is a spike, goal pause of 120 frames releases it; last 30 s the scoreboard pulses and a one-double gap stays winnable.
END. Totals, doubles for and against, gold pucks stolen and lost, a one-line cause, R for rematch. Win offers the next level on HOME. Best margin shown for the session only; nothing saves.
PHASE ONE. Cartridge, gold observer, flash and totals on flat shapes; a person plays five minutes. Bumper positions, rink size and shot scale are paper choices tuned there and checked with rink.sh check-cartridge (owner ruling 8).
brief.arena: A bright outdoor-pond sheet, 70 x 35 m, corner radius 3.5 m, nets at both ends. Four magenta bumper bollards, 3 m across, stand at x ±29, z ±12, about 4 m off the side boards. Two orange fast lanes, 36 x 5 m, run along the sides at z ±13.5 and feed the corners. Two blue slush circles, radius 4 m, sit at x ±10 on the centre line. Nothing moves or respawns; what changes during a round is the puck, which turns gold. The base's rink_toys draws zones and bumpers. thirdjam's hall surrounds the smaller sheet; benches stand slightly off the boards. Camera: the core's chase view, 6 m back, 3.5 m up, bound to your skater, held inside the boards by the core, so scenery never covers it; radar shows off-screen play.
brief.ai: Opponents are the Pond Wardens in orange, thirdjam's bots, sharing your skater figure (a core limit: only colour, name and role differ). Brann, chaser: goes straight for the carrier; the tell is a long straight closing line, then a 12-frame check wind-up, short of the 20-frame standard because the core caps it. Beat Brann with a late turn or a bank pass to yourself. Ilse and Otto, supports: wait off the puck for passes and rebounds, so they pounce on loose gold; deny them by shooting from the far lane. Grit, back: stays home, saves low shots in reach, reads long straight shots, commits to the old side of a deke; beat Grit with a bank that crosses the crease. Hits and misses use the core's stumble and fall. Barks come from the bank when they score or concede. Tiers: rookie never body checks, stick read 14 frames late; pro checks, 8; all-star reads 5 and shoots sharper. First match is rookie: clumsy, never absent. Your Magpie mates are chaser, support and back at the same level.
brief.controls: Move (WASD): skate. Aim (mouse): point the stick, shot or pass. Primary (left mouse): shoot with puck, poke without. Secondary (right mouse): pass with puck, check without. Sprint (Shift): burst on a stamina bar. Brake (Space): stop hard. thirdjam's own bindings win wherever they differ; R on the end card rematches.
brief.mood: Crisp winter daylight, orange fast lanes, blue slush, magenta bumpers that flash white with a pinball bang; a gold puck trail, a horn and confetti for every double, cheeky commentary.

pillars.line: Sensation and aim: a bumper is a pass to yourself that you hear, see and chase.
pillars.rules_out: Moving, random or mid-ice bumpers, and rebounds nobody can learn.

pillars.line: The ice makes every route a choice between speed and the straight line.
pillars.rules_out: Invisible, decorative or randomly shifting patches, and speed pickups.

pillars.line: Every gold puck has an answer: steal it, block it, or hit its chaser.
pillars.rules_out: Protected gold pucks, auto-scoring, aim magnets toward bumpers, and hidden rival boosts.

verbs.input: Left mouse with puck; hold charges. Aim at a bumper face or the net. Core's own shot animation.
verbs.cancel: Core shot cooldown 24 frames; skating stays free, so chase your kick at once.

verbs.input: Right mouse with puck toward a mate; hold goes further. A feed across the crease invites a one-timer.
verbs.cancel: Receiver may shoot within 20 frames as a one-timer. Provisional frames; the core's values win.

verbs.input: Left mouse without puck, stick aimed at it. Core's poke animation. Steals a gold puck.
verbs.cancel: Success frees the puck; a miss locks your stick while skating continues. Provisional frames.

verbs.input: Right mouse without puck while closing on a man. Core's body check animation.
verbs.cancel: Momentum decides bump, stumble or fall; a miss costs speed. Window 12; other frames provisional.

loops.s3: Shoot straight for one, or bank for two and risk losing the puck? Players learn favourite bumper angles.
loops.s30: Fast lane or slush shortcut, who chases the kick, who stays back: attacks bend toward corners and counters follow.
loops.m3: Protect a lead by stealing gold, or chase doubles when behind; late games become corner races.

context: A gold puck turns both teams from carrying to racing for the rebound.
Trailing by two or more lengthens your gold window from three seconds to four.
The last thirty seconds put a single double within reach of flipping close games.
Winning unlocks the urge for a sharper level: bots check and read sticks sooner.

skill.floor: Skate toward the net and click; any goal counts, and a lucky bumper shows the double.
ceiling: Shoulder bank: strike the bumper's inner side so the kick spits across the crease.
Lane chase: release early from fast ice and beat defenders to your own rebound.
Gold feed: collect the kick, pass across the crease, and one-time it before gold fades.

feel.knockback: Core momentum law unchanged: closing speed and mass decide bump, stumble or knockdown; boards add force.
feel.reaction: Both skaters answer contact through the core's figures; bumpers flash six frames, bang, and gild the puck's trail.
feel.whiff: Missed poke locks the stick; missed check loses speed. No spark, shake or bang.
feel.shake: Only a double goal: 0.2 m over 14 frames. Core contact feel stays; bumper touches never shake aim.
feel.camera: thirdjam chase, unchanged: 6 m back, 3.5 up, 5 ahead, lag 4 frames, 70 degrees, bound to your skater.

clips.moment: Puck hits a corner bumper, flashes gold, and the trickster pounces to bury it for two.
A gold kick is fed across the crease and one-timed before the back can cross.
A defender pokes the gold puck away at the last instant and breaks down the fast lane.

design.first_minute: Puck drops against rookies. One hint: bank off a corner bumper, score double. First flash teaches gold; first +2 teaches pouncing.
design.fail_state: End card shows totals, doubles for and against, gold pucks lost, the main cause, and R for an instant rematch.
out_of_scope: New skating, puck physics, bots or camera, and any rink core patch.
New rival bodies or animations; Wardens use thirdjam's skater figure.
Pickups, abilities, penalties, moving bumpers or shifting patches.
Bots that deliberately aim bank shots.
Saved progress, online play and gamepad rebinding.
